title: Factorization through the open mate before using its invertibility
statement: Let f:X→Y be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism with Y qcqs, and choose a right adjoint a to its canonical lifted derived direct image, with its adjunction. Let V⊂Y be affine, U=f inverse(V) be qcqs, T be qcqs, and gV:T→V and g0:T→Y satisfy gV followed by V→Y equals g0. Choose right adjoints c,b,b prime,aV, with adjunctions, for the canonical lifted derived direct images X times_Y T→T, U→V, U times_V T→T, and X times_Y V→V respectively. Assume the canonical ordinary derived base-change maps for f along g0, f restricted to V along gV, and f along V→Y are isomorphisms on quasi-coherent derived objects. Fix K in D_QCoh(Y). Put B=U times_V T, A=X times_Y T, P=X times_Y V. Let s:B→A and t:B→P have projections s_X=t_X=B→U→X, s_T=B→T, and t_V=B→T→V. Let G be the ambient global mate at K pulled back along s, O be the ambient mate for f along V→Y at K pulled back along t, and L be the ambient local mate for U→V along gV at LV* K. There exist isomorphisms e0:source(G)≅source(O), e1:target(O)≅source(L), e2:target(G)≅target(L) with G followed by e2 = e0 followed by O followed by e1 followed by L. Invertibility of O, G or L is not assumed. The schemes, categories, functors, canonical adjoints, base change and mates are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint, def-pc-derived-base-change-map, def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map].

proof.text: The cartesian restriction square and its pullback along gV identify U times_V T with the iterated pullback of f first along V and then along T. The equations on s and t are their unique projection equations. Pullback composition supplies e0 on the source of the global mate and the source of the t-pulled open mate.

Identify U with pullback(f,V inclusion) by pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict. Derived direct-image composition and right-adjoint uniqueness identify aV with b under this transport; pull this comparison to U times_V T to obtain e1. The isomorphism s to pullback(f,g0) similarly transports its direct image, giving e2 by right-adjoint uniqueness between c and b prime. These comparisons are tied to the supplied adjunctions, not arbitrary unrelated endpoint isomorphisms.

Expand the fixed canonical mates using their units, inverse conjugates of ordinary base change, and counits. The scalar base-change upper-left transport is schemeDerivedBaseChange_pasting. For the two successive base squares, transpose under the composite adjunction: naturality and the triangle identities turn their pasted transpose into the transpose of the rectangle, by associativity of the selected derived-pullback comparisons. ConjugateEquiv respects composition and inverses. Naturality of the two units moves the conjugates through their units; naturality of the counits and the triangle identities cancel the middle unit/counit pair. The remaining four factors are e0, the t-pulled open mate, e1, and the local mate, followed on the other side by e2. This proves the displayed equality without inverting the open mate.

theorem rightAdjoint_mate_oldBase_open_factorization
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y T : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (V : Y.Opens) [IsAffine V.toScheme]
    [CompactSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme]
    (g0 : T ⟶ Y) (gV : T ⟶ V.toScheme) (hg : gV ≫ V.ι = g0)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g0))
    (adjc : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g0)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g0)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g0)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g0) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ c)
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g0) g0
        (pullback.fst f g0) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (b : schemeDerivedQCohCategory V.toScheme ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (b' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback (f ∣_ V) gV))
    (adjb : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty V.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ V))
      (fun E ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ (f ∣_ V)).fst
        E.obj E.property) ⊣ b)
    (adjb' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (f ∣_ V) gV)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated
          (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ b')
    (hβV : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (f ∣_ V)
        (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV) gV
        (pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) gV) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (aV : schemeDerivedQCohCategory V.toScheme ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f V.ι))
    (adjV : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty V.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f V.ι)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f V.ι)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f V.ι)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f V.ι) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ aV)
    (hβ₀ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f V.ι) V.ι
        (pullback.fst f V.ι) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (s : pullback (f ∣_ V) gV ⟶ pullback f g0)
    (t : pullback (f ∣_ V) gV ⟶ pullback f V.ι)
    (hs₁ : s ≫ pullback.fst f g0 =
      pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) gV ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)
    (hs₂ : s ≫ pullback.snd f g0 = pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV)
    (ht₁ : t ≫ pullback.fst f V.ι =
      pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) gV ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)
    (ht₂ : t ≫ pullback.snd f V.ι = pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV ≫ gV) :
    let G := Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback s).map
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g0)).ι.map
        (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y T
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
          f g0 a c adjf adjc hβ K)))
    let O := Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback t).map
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f V.ι)).ι.map
        (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y V.toScheme
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
          f V.ι a aV adjf adjV hβ₀ K)))
    let L := Arrow.mk ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (f ∣_ V) gV)).ι.map
      (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap (f ∣_ V) gV b b' adjb adjb' hβV
        ⟨(derivedPullback V.ι).obj K.obj,
          (derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh V.ι).1 K.obj K.property⟩))
    ∃ (e₀ : G.left ≅ O.left) (e₁ : O.right ≅ L.left) (e₂ : G.right ≅ L.right),
      G.hom ≫ e₂.hom = e₀.hom ≫ O.hom ≫ e₁.hom ≫ L.hom
